name: Stochastic Gradient Estimation for Differentiable Rasterization
aliases: Per-Pixel Stochastic Gradient Estimation for Differentiable Rasterization
definition: A method to transform a non-differentiable rasterizer into a differentiable one by using stochastic gradient estimation, allowing gradient descent optimization within an existing rasterization engine.
summary: This method converts non-differentiable rasterizers into differentiable ones by estimating gradients per-pixel, avoiding the high noise of full-image approaches and requiring no external deep learning frameworks.
